name: Synthwave
author: Flubsound (Flubes & Claude)
description: For synth-led music: synthwave, retrowave and outrun, synth-pop, and progressive house and electro in the deadmau5 vein. A solid sub lift (about +2 dB at 31 Hz and +1.3 dB at 63 Hz, adaptive with headroom protection, mono below 120 Hz) that leaves the kick's 125 Hz punch where it was, Warmth at 30 % for an analogue Tube body, synth leads and plucky arpeggios brought forward around 3 kHz (on pink noise 2-4 kHz sit about 1.3 dB above the mids) with a touch of air, and pads widened above 220 Hz with a little space; Mono Safety pulls the width back if the image would collapse. Punch is kept low and the glue light, so build-ups and drops keep their dynamics.
